title: Propane stove and 1 lb cylinders
summary: Outdoors only: connect, leak-test with soapy water, store away from heat, and keep CO out of the house.

sources.title: Coleman 5459 series camp stove manual (hosted on ManualsLib)
Coleman 9992-647 manual: leak testing (hosted on ManualsDir)

blocks.text: **Propane camp stoves are for outdoor use only.** Never use one in a tent, camper, vehicle, house, garage or other enclosed space. It uses up oxygen and makes carbon monoxide. Never cook inside, even with a window open.

items: Use only the **disposable 16.4 oz (1 lb)** cylinders the stove is made for.
Don't store or use cylinders bigger than the maker allows. Coleman says cylinders over 2.5 lbs of water capacity are unsafe and illegal in some places.
Go **outside**, away from flames and sparks. Make sure the burner valves are off.
Thread the cylinder onto the regulator **by hand** until it is snug.
**Leak-test every time you connect a cylinder** (next section) before you light the stove.
Light the stove. Never leave it unattended while it is hot or in use.
Mix **equal parts mild dish soap and water**.
Brush it on the connection between the cylinder and the regulator, and any other fittings.
Watch for **bubbles**. Bubbles mean a leak.
Leak? Close the valves, remove the cylinder, retighten or replace the part, and test again. If it still leaks, don't use the stove. Contact the maker or a propane dealer.

blocks.text: **Never test for leaks with a flame.** No smoking and no open flames nearby.

items: Close both burner valves, let the stove cool, then remove the cylinder and put the protective cap back on.
**Never store propane where it can get hotter than 120°F (49°C)**: a hot car, a sunny spot, near a heater, flame or pilot light.
Disconnect the cylinder when the stove is in storage.
Keep gasoline and other flammable liquids and vapors away from the stove.

blocks.text: CO symptoms: headache, dizziness, fatigue, nausea, flu-like feeling. If you feel them, get into fresh air and call for help. See the carbon monoxide guide.
